topics.title: Start
topics.teach: This lesson is not the 3D printing and coral assessment. Read the route. An official PRE or POST appears on your program page only when an instructor links one.

topics.title: Coral
topics.teach: Coral is an animal. Algae sharing food they made is symbiosis. Tentacles sweeping food from the water is the animal capturing food.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: What kind of living thing coral is, and how it gets food

fields.name: care
fields.label: One way a reef cares for other living things

items.label: Tentacles sweeping food from the water

topics.title: Species
topics.teach: Use the features. Wave and verrucae point to rose coral. Papillae point to rice coral. Fingers in a calm bay point to finger coral. One free disk is mushroom coral.

topics.title: Harm
topics.teach: Plain water leaves the chalk looking the same. An acid changes calcium carbonate in a way you do not undo.

fields.name: change
fields.label: What the acid does, and whether you can undo it

topics.title: Record
topics.teach: A card has a role, who depends on it, the conditions, and where it lives. A clean model for another app is mesh. A photorealistic scene is splat. Move slowly and cover above and below.

items.label: A clean model for another app
A photorealistic scene with the background

topics.title: Shape
topics.teach: Name a change in form and a condition such as wave, depth, or light. The species stays the same.

fields.name: changes
fields.label: What changes in the form, and which condition

items.label: Finger coral in a calm bay

topics.title: Change
topics.teach: Scientists map a reef for health, for events such as runoff, and for which species are there. A map can cover more area than one swim.

fields.name: difference
fields.label: One visible difference you would look for

topics.title: Wrap
topics.teach: Connect the animal, a condition of the place, and the scan or the map.
